pages.text: If you find yourself waking up in a place with only Gravels and Stones, this Chapter is exactly what you need.$(br)If you want to know how to gain certain materials, this Chapter is also useful.$(br2)The first thing that you need to do is to collect some $(item)Gravels$() and $(item)Flints$(), and craft some $(item)Sharpen Flint$(). Use it by right clicking.

Now, get some $(item)Bone Meal$() from some where, and make some $(item)Moss Block$().$(br2)You might also want some $(item)Cobblestone With Moss$(), $(item)Moss Block$() and extend on it by $(item)Bone Meal$().
Then you will be able to get $(item)Logs$() from $(item)Azalea$(). The next things you need to make are $(item)Hand Vacuum$() and $(item)Dust Source$().

Now place the $(l:dust/dust_source)Dust Source$() a few blocks(~2) above the floor, and make sure the floor blocks are having the tag $(item)#dustandash:dust_able$().$(br)Then wait until $(item)Dust$() spawn.$(br2)After that, use$(item)Hand Vacuum$() to collect $(item)Dust$()s. You will be able to have three of the five $(l:dust/basic_dust)Basic Dust$(/l).
